Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: MSA redlines + portal onboarding: action items & checkpoints

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. Attached is our current MSA redline (MSA_Redline_v3.pdf). Before we proceed with DocuSign, we want to confirm the sequencing with your procurement portal (Ariba):

- Does Acme require a fully executed MSA before a vendor record can be created in Ariba?
- If not, can you create a provisional vendor record so we can receive POs while legal completes signature?
- Are there any mandatory PO metadata fields that block PO creation (GL code, remit address, vendor tax id, vendor type)? If so, please share the exact field names or a screenshot.

Kimberly & Connor — looping you in for ops/finance gating and to capture any PO field constraints so we can reflect them in the order form. Mateo — flagging the redline for legal review and ask: can Redwood accept a countersign via DocuSign and let Acme provision the vendor in parallel?

Thanks — want to avoid a hard stop at procurement after legal signs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: MSA_Redline_v3.pdf
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@acmepharma.com>

Date: 2027-12-01T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines + portal onboarding: action items & checkpoints

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate you sending the redline. Quick answers from procurement:

- We can create a vendor record in Ariba before the MSA is fully executed, but payment will be restricted until legal and finance confirm the payment terms are acceptable. In practice this means: provisional vendor -> limited PO acceptance (pilot/sandbox) -> full enablement after signature.
- Required fields that can block PO acceptance: "Vendor Tax ID (TIN)", "Remit Address", "Banking Reference (for ePayments)" and our internal "GL Cost Center Code". I've attached a screenshot of the registration summary (Acme_Ariba_Screenshot.png).

If your legal team can accept DocuSign countersignature, we can proceed with provisional provisioning while signatures are in flight. Procurement prefers we have a clear plan for when the vendor moves from provisional -> approved.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Sara
Sara Patel
Sr. Manager, Strategic Sourcing — Acme Pharma
sara.patel@acmepharma.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-12-01T13:26:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines + portal onboarding: action items & checkpoints

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the ping and for the redline. Quick legal posture:

- We can accept DocuSign countersignature from Acme provided the executed DocuSign summary includes the final signature audit trail and the final MSA PDF is stored in both parties' contract repositories.
- Our primary ask is that any provisional vendor status explicitly restricts financial exposure: limit total PO dollar amount or set pilot-only PO types until the MSA is fully executed. I recommend we capture that in a short "order form rider" (1 paragraph) that procurement can attach to provisional POs.

I've incorporated a couple of targeted edits addressing liability and pilot limits — attached as MSA_Redline_v4.pdf. I'm happy to talk through the small language changes; they are intentionally narrow to avoid delaying onboarding.

For ops: Connor / Kimberly, if you can confirm the minimum set of fields Redwood can supply immediately (TIN, remit address, bank remittance placeholder), legal will proceed with DocuSign and we can provide the final MSA for signature.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

Subject: Question for Ariba: provisional vendor status & PO routing fields

Hi Ariba team / Acme procurement —

Following up on sequencing. A few operational questions so Redwood's finance and ops can prepare:

1) Can Ariba create a provisional vendor record that allows receiving a limited PO (pilot) while final MSA is in-flight? If yes, what specific status name will appear so our finance team can recognize it in the PO workflow?

2) On the PO side, can Ariba accept a placeholder for "Banking Reference" during provisional status and allow update after signature? Are there validation rules for Remit Address or TIN formats?

3) If Acme enforces a "pilot-only" PO type, can Redwood's order form include a one-line rider limiting the pilot spend and duration (e.g., up to $25k or 90 days)? Mateo has provided language we can attach.

For traceability, the HubSpot deal is here: https://hubspot.com/deal/HS-76382. If you prefer a call, we're available this afternoon.

Thanks —
Marissa

Date: 2027-12-02T14:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Question for Ariba: provisional vendor status & PO routing fields

Hi Marissa / Sara —

Thanks for the details. Short answers from Ariba onboarding:

- Yes — Ariba supports a "pending approval" (provisional) vendor status that can be used to create POs marked as "Pilot". Those POs can be routed but payment will remain on hold until vendor moves to "Active". The status label is configurable; Acme is currently using "Pending Approval".
- Placeholder values for Banking Reference and Remit Address are acceptable for provisional POs, but TIN/Tax ID is required to progress to Active. Format validation is controlled by Acme's tenant rules; if you send a sample TIN it can be validated pre-submission.
- We support metadata fields called: "Vendor_TIN", "Remit_Address_Line1", "Remit_Postal_Code", "Banking_Ref", and "GL_CostCenter". You can pre-populate and update them after signature.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Redwood provides TIN, remit address, and provisional banking placeholder to procure-team@acmepharma.com.
2) Mateo confirms the one-paragraph pilot rider language and we attach it to pilot POs.
3) Legal completes DocuSign execution and uploads the final MSA to both contract repositories — Ariba will accept the DocuSign audit trail link for record matching.

If you want, we can stand up a 30-minute call to walk through the registration form and map the field names live.

Regards,
Ariba Onboarding Support
onboard@ariba.com
